coordinates.definition: pixel-centre x and y of the target pixel in the cube's Albers equal-area CRS (lat0 36, lon0 85, WGS 84), metres, untransformed
coordinates.source: row-shard x_coord/y_coord keyed by (rgiid, pixel_flat_index); verified against chip axes, the cube GeoTransform and the cube coordinate arrays
coordinates.as_float32: XGBoost input dtype; spacing 0.125 m at the largest coordinate

model.tuning: none; accepted parameters for both arms
model.colsample_bytree_note: fraction kept; with 27 columns the ON arm samples among more candidates

metrics.pixel: glacier-balanced weights 1/(R_g * N_gr * G): MAE, RMSE, signed bias; NMAD = 1.4826 * weighted median of |e - weighted median(e)| with the same weights
metrics.glacier_specific: E_gr = summed void error / valid glacier pixels; per glacier mean of |E_gr|, of E_gr^2, of E_gr over realizations; then equal-glacier means. MAE, RMSE, bias; NMAD = 1.4826 * median |m - median(m)| of per-glacier mean errors m
metrics.integrated: V_gr = summed void error * 900 m^2; MAE, RMSE, bias as for glacier-specific
metrics.nmad_note: one implementation for every method in this run's tables; frozen pipeline NMAD may differ slightly and is not mixed in

primary_contrast.definition: coords_off minus coords_on_absolute; negative error-magnitude differences favour excluding coordinates
primary_contrast.bias_metrics: abs(regional signed bias_off) - abs(regional signed bias_on) for glacier, pixel and integrated bias; signed biases also reported
primary_contrast.ratios: secondary only; none formed with near-zero bias

intervals.blocks: frozen 100-km block assignment of the release bootstrap
intervals.resampling: whole blocks with replacement within each region (combined: both regions resampled together, stratified by region); all realizations of a glacier kept
intervals.paired: the same draws for both arms and every metric
intervals.meaning: conditional descriptive intervals for this fixed fitted pair; not training uncertainty; no equivalence margin is declared

interpretation_rules: A worse ON or OFF score is a valid finding.
The ON model is not promoted if it scores better; the production model is unchanged.
Similar or better OFF scores do not show that the other features carry no spatial information.
An interval spanning zero does not establish equivalence.
Regional transfer answers a different question and is reported separately.
